sync-docs.title: Sync Docs
sync-docs.description: Pre-PR step: review strad's documentation against the branch diff and update whatever has gone stale — README.md, AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, docs/, HACKS.md, strad.config.example.yaml — so docs ship in the same PR and never drift from code. Default, always-on: run it as the final routine before opening a PR. Vendored copy of the central Reframe sync-docs skill, adapted to strad's documentation surface.
